values.heading: Supports mass deportation
values.description: Post endorses mass deportation, detention or suspending asylum, or frames immigration as an 'invasion' or deliberate population replacement.

periods.note: The right was split on immigration: in 2014, 73% of Steadfast Conservatives vs. 21% of Business Conservatives saw immigrants as a burden.

Partisan gaps widened sharply from 2017. In 2024, 88% of Trump supporters vs. 27% of Harris supporters favored mass deportation. In 2026 support was 0–15% across left groups and 27–81% across right groups.
